description: Antennes du Conseil Général is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Collectivité Territoriale de Guyane. Localisation et coordonnées des antennes du Conseil Général (non exhaustif). Coverage: Collectivité Territoriale de Guyane. The publisher named on the listing is Collectivité Territoriale de Guyane. Its keywords include equipements-et-services-publics, french-guiana, 2013, societe, guyane-1, departement. The listing shows 2 download or service links in ZIP, OGC:WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
